'''Berin Thane''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident. He is the brother of [[Jon Thane]].

== Activities ==
His house is burnt down during the [[Trolloc]] raid in [[Emond's Field]].

He helps defend Emond's Field against the invading Trolloc army.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He is one of the Two Rivers men to follow [[Perrin Aybara]] into [[Ghealdan]]. He falls asleep at his post while on guard duty and has to be woken by Perrin.
